topic: Asking the Orthodontist about Braces for a Child

script.title: ASKING ABOUT BRACES
script.story_hook: Two rows of teeth, and one very big question.
script.intro_zh: 兩排牙齒，還有一個很大的問題。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to an orthodontic clinic on a school day. Listen for teeth talk and money words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到上學日裡的矯正診所。留意關於牙齒的說法，還有講錢的用詞。
script.outro: And that's a braces plan for a nine year old. Listen once more and answer out loud.
script.outro_zh: 九歲孩子的牙套計畫就這樣有了輪廓。再聽一次，大聲回答一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now say each line back to us.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在把每一句跟著我們說回來。
script.title_quote: He has two rows of teeth
script.char_a_description: an easygoing man in his forties with a shaved head and a short salt-and-pepper beard, an olive flannel shirt, soft canvas shoes, and a broad build
script.char_b_description: a warm woman in her mid thirties with a platinum blonde pixie cut, clear round glasses, a mint green scrub top under a white lab coat, and a tall build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, thanks for fitting us in this afternoon, doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ θæŋks fɚ ˈfɪɾɪŋ ʌs ɪn ðɪs ˈæftɚˌnuːn ˈdɑkɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，謝謝你今天下午還幫我們塞進來看診，醫師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, call me Nora, and welcome to our little clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kɔl mi ˈnɔɹə ænd ˈwɛlkəm tə ɑːɹ ˈlɪɾəl ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 請叫我 Nora 就好，歡迎來我們的小診所。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, Nora, is nine too early for braces?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm ˈnɔɹə ɪz naɪn tu ˈɜɹli fɚ bɹeɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，Nora，九歲開始戴牙套會不會太早？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine is actually a good year, here's the reason.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪz ˈæktʃuəli ə ɡʊd jɪɹ hɪɹz ðə ˈɹizən/
dialogue.zh: 九歲其實是很適合的年齡，原因在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good year? He still has baby teeth, plenty left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd jɪɹ hi stɪl hæz ˈbeɪbi tɪθ ˈplɛnɾi lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 很好的年齡？他還有乳牙，好多還沒掉呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal, some fall out late, no rush there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈnɔɹməl sʌm fɔl aʊt leɪt noʊ ɹʌʃ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那很正常，有些牙齒掉得晚，這個不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, right. He has two rows of teeth, somehow.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɹaɪt hi hæz tu ɹoʊz əv tɪθ ˈsʌmˌhaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，也是。他不知怎麼已經有兩排牙齒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shark teeth! I see that every month, it's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑɹk tɪθ aɪ si ðæt ˈɛvɹi mʌnθ ɪts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 鯊魚牙！我每個月都會看到，這沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every month? That makes me feel much better, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi mʌnθ ðæt meɪks mi fil mʌtʃ ˈbɛɾɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 每個月都會看到？那老實說讓我安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We look for room, not how many teeth show.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lʊk fɚ ɹum nɑt haʊ ˈmɛni tɪθ ʃoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們看的是空間，不是數他露出幾顆牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room, okay, so if there's no room, teeth crowd?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹum oʊˈkeɪ soʊ ɪf ðɛɹz noʊ ɹum tɪθ kɹaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 空間，好，所以如果沒有空間，牙齒就會擠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, they crowd, and then brushing becomes a battle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðeɪ kɹaʊd ænd ðɛn ˈbɹʌʃɪŋ bɪˈkʌmz ə ˈbæɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，它們會擠，然後刷牙就變成一場戰爭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's us every night, and he fights the toothbrush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ʌs ˈɛvɹi naɪt ænd hi faɪts ðə ˈtuθˌbɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們家每天晚上都這樣，他會跟牙刷對抗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, parents always admit that part, all of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈpɛɹənts ˈɔlweɪz ædˈmɪt ðæt pɑɹt ɔl əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，爸媽都會承認這一段，每一個都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what happens first, do we start braces today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ˈhæpənz fɝst du wi stɑɹt ˈbɹeɪsɪz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那首先要做什麼，我們今天就裝牙套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, first an X-ray, it's quick, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt fɝst ən ˈɛksˌɹeɪ ɪts kwɪk aɪ pɹəˈmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 還不用，先照一張 X 光，很快，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An X-ray, sure. What does that show you exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈɛksˌɹeɪ ʃʊɹ wʌt dʌz ðæt ʃoʊ ju ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 照 X 光，好啊。那可以讓你看見什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows the teeth still under the gum line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoz ðə tɪθ stɪl ˈʌndɚ ðə ɡʌm laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 它讓我看到還在牙齦下面的牙齒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the gum, so you can plan the path.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə ɡʌm soʊ ju kæn plæn ðə pæθ/
dialogue.zh: 在牙齦下面，所以你能規劃牙齒走的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I can see if any tooth is missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd aɪ kæn si ɪf ˈɛni tuθ ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，我也可以看有沒有缺牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missing? Um, can teeth just not be there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ ʌm kæn tɪθ dʒʌst nɑt bi ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 缺牙？嗯，牙齒會不會本來就沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, then we open space or close it later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðɛn wi ˈoʊpən speɪs ɔɹ kloʊz ɪt ˈleɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有時候會，那樣我們可以把空間撐開，或是之後再把它收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that sounds smart. Does the X-ray hurt?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈsaʊndz smɑɹt dʌz ði ˈɛksˌɹeɪ hɝt/
dialogue.zh: 好，這聽起來挺聰明的。照 X 光會痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just a still face, ten seconds, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌst ə stɪl feɪs tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 不會，只要臉保持不動，十秒，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He can hold still, he sits through movies fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn hoʊld stɪl hi sɪts θɹu ˈmɔviz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 他可以不動，他看電影都坐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect test, movies are my secret tool here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt tɛst ˈmɔviz ɑɹ maɪ ˈsiːˌkɹɪt tuːl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 完美的測試，電影是我在這裡的秘密工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Secret tool, ha, I'll use that at home too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsiːˌkɹɪt tuːl hɑ aɪl juz ðæt æt hoʊm tu/
dialogue.zh: 秘密工具，哈，我在家裡也要用這招。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, after the X-ray, we talk about choices.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈæftɚ ði ˈɛksˌɹeɪ wi tɔk əˈbaʊt ˈtʃɔɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 所以，照完 X 光之後，我們來談選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choices? I thought braces were just metal squares.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɔɪsəz aɪ θɑt bɹeɪsɪz wɚ dʒʌst ˈmɛɾəl skwɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 選項？我以為牙套就是金屬的小方塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Metal is one, and it's still the best for many.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛɾəl ɪz wʌn ænd ɪts stɪl ðə bɛst fɚ ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 金屬是一種，而且對很多人來說它還是最好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the other choice is those clear plastic trays?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ˈʌðɚ tʃɔɪs ɪz ðoz klɪɹ ˈplæsɪk tɹeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 另一種就是那些透明的塑膠托盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, trays, but at nine metal usually works faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɹeɪz bʌt æt naɪn ˈmɛɾəl ˈjuʒəwəli wɝks ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，透明托盤，但九歲通常金屬效果更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Faster is good, he forgets everything, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstɚ ɪz ɡʊd hi fɚˈɡɛts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 快比較好，老實說，他什麼都會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then metal it is, um, unless you have a preference?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈmɛɾəl ɪt ɪz ʌm ʌnˈlɛs ju hæv ə ˈpɹɛfɚəns/
dialogue.zh: 那就選金屬，嗯，除非你有偏好的款式？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No preference, only one worry, does it look loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɛfɚəns ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈwɝi dʌz ɪt lʊk laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 沒有偏好，只有一個擔心，它會不會看起來很張揚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, loud! Kids don't care, their friends have them.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈlaʊd ˈkɪdz doʊnt ˈkɛɹ ðɛɹ ˈfɹɛndz hæv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，很張揚！小孩才不在意，他的朋友都在戴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's true, half his class has braces, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈtɹu hæf ɪz klæs hæz bɹeɪsɪz aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，他們班上一半都有牙套，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he's normal there, and that's the biggest thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hɪz ˈnɔɹməl ðɛɹ ænd ðæts ðə ˈbɪɡəst θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那他在班上就是普通一個，這點才最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Now the money part, is that monthly?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ naʊ ðə ˈmʌni pɑɹt ɪz ðæt ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 好。現在談錢的部分，那是按月付的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, monthly payments, and there's no interest at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmʌnθli ˈpeɪmənts ænd ðɛɹz noʊ ˈɪntɹəst ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 是的，每月付一筆，而且完全沒有利息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No interest, that helps, my plan covers part, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɪntɹəst ðæt hɛlps maɪ plæn ˈkʌvɚz pɑɹt aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 沒有利息，那很有幫助，我的保險應該有付一部分吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me your insurance card, I'll check it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi jɔɹ ˈɪnʃɚəns kɑɹd aɪl tʃɛk ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 把你的保險卡傳給我，我今天就會幫你查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's in my car, well, can I bring it later?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn maɪ kɑɹ wɛl kæn aɪ brɪŋ ɪt ˈleɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 卡在我的車上，嗯，我晚一點拿來可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, and I'll hold your X-ray slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ænd aɪl hoʊld jɔɹ ˈɛksˌɹeɪ slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，我會先幫你保留 X 光的時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do braces stay on, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du bɹeɪsɪz steɪ ɑn ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 牙套大概要戴多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen months is common, sometimes two years for kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin mʌnθs ɪz ˈkɑmən ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz tu jɪɹz fɚ kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 十八個月很常見，小孩有時候要兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighteen months, okay, we can do eighteen months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin ˈmʌnθs oʊˈkeɪ wi kæn du ˌeɪˈtin ˈmʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 十八個月，好，這我們做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food rules are small, no gum, no hard candy.
dialogue.phonetic: /fud ɹulz ɑɹ smɑl noʊ ɡʌm noʊ hɑɹd ˈkændi/
dialogue.zh: 飲食規則很少，不能嚼口香糖，不能吃硬的糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No gum? He chews that thing every single day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɡʌm hi tʃuz ðæt θɪŋ ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不能嚼口香糖？他每一天都在嚼那個東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll say goodbye to gum, sorry, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wil seɪ ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ tu ɡʌm ˈsɑɹi hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就跟口香糖說再見，抱歉，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Accepted! What about after the braces come off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ækˈsɛptɪd wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈæftɚ ðə ˈbɹeɪsɪz kʌm ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 我接受啦。那牙套拆掉之後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A retainer at night, that's the quiet final step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɹɪˈteɪnɚ æt naɪt ðæts ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈfaɪnəl stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 晚上戴維持器，那就是最後一步，很安靜的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night only, that's not so hard to remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈoʊnli ðæts nɑt soʊ hɑɹd tə ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只有晚上要戴，那應該不難記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most kids forget twice, then they stop forgetting.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst kɪdz fɚˈɡɛt twaɪs ðɛn ðeɪ stɑp fɚˈɡɛɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 多數小孩會忘記兩次，然後就不再忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'll put a sticky note on the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪl pʊt ə ˈstɪki noʊt ɑn ðə ˈmɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我會貼一張便條在鏡子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do that, and bring him Saturday for the X-ray.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðæt ænd brɪŋ hɪm ˈsætɚˌdeɪ fɚ ði ˈɛksˌɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那樣做，然後週六帶他來照 X 光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning works. Is there a fee for that visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ wɝks ɪz ðɛɹ ə fi fɚ ðæt ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週六早上可以。那一次要收錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's all included in the plan, so Saturday is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔl ɪnˈkludɪd ɪn ðə plæn soʊ ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ɪz ˈfɹi/
dialogue.zh: 這些都含在計畫裡，所以週六那趟不用付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing to pay? That's an obvious yes, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ tə ˈpeɪ ðæts ən əbˈviəs jɛs θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 不用付錢？那答案很明顯，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday then, and tell him shark teeth are cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ðɛn ænd tɛl hɪm ʃɑɹk tɪθ ɑɹ kul/
dialogue.zh: 那就週六見，記得跟他說鯊魚牙很酷。

script.youtube_title: 【矯正診所問牙套🦷】「他怎麼有兩排牙齒」教你九歲開始矯正要問什麼🎧💳🩺｜聽完會問分期與維持器｜60句沉浸式英文聽力｜Asking About Braces
script.youtube_title_en: "He Has Two Rows of Teeth" — Asking the Orthodontist About Braces at Nine
script.youtube_description:
孩子九歲，牙齒排成兩層，到底現在該不該戴牙套？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景在矯正診所的診療椅旁，從問年齡、問 X 光，一路聽到金屬與透明托盤、每月分期、還有拆掉之後的維持器。

你會聽到：怎麼問 is nine too early for braces；為什麼診所要先照 X 光，牙齦下面的牙能看出什麼；乳牙還沒掉完算不算問題；還有牙套要戴多久、能不能按月付、有沒有利息、保險卡怎麼交、口香糖為什麼要停的實用問句。

小朋友張開嘴，上面一排、下面也一排，牙齒好像長了兩倍。九歲到底是不是開始戴牙套的好時機？診所為什麼堅持要先照一張 X 光？

這一集帶大家走進一間矯正診所，從問年齡、問兩排牙齒是否正常、先照 X 光看牙齦下面，一路聽到金屬牙套與透明托盤的差別、十八個月的時間、按月付錢與沒有利息的安排，最後還有拆掉之後的維持器，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🦷 問年齡：So, um, Nora, is nine too early for braces?

💳 談錢：Yes, monthly payments, and there's no interest at all.
